# Experiment Campaign

## Purpose

Design or synthesize a multi-round empirical campaign while every execution remains root-controlled.

## Preconditions

Use explicit workflow approval. Any multiple-repository or declared network need is handled by the root, and supplied round Results and artifacts are fixed inputs.

## Inputs

Use the campaign objective, protocol family, supplied prior rounds, repository and artifact snapshots, budget and limits, and checks.

## Procedure

Define round sequence and decision points, compare supplied outcomes, track controls, parameter coverage, and stopping rules, and propose separately validated future rounds.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with campaign synthesis or plan plus one pending Proposal containing supported root-side round, artifact, or evidence actions.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on budget or limit breach, incomparable rounds, provenance gaps, direct network or repository expansion, or any request to self-launch work.

## Authority Boundaries

The Dispatch limit is an orchestration ceiling, not launch authority. Do not use network, traverse repositories, create Dispatches, invoke nested agents, mutate campaigns, or expand the sandbox.
